title: Base change commutes with the relative unit of one open
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Work in the unbounded derived categories of modules [def-pc-derived-category], with K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For any open W⊆X, let αW and αX be the local and global arrows of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. If jW:W→X and jW′:X′×_X W→X′ are the inclusions, then Lg*(relativeMVUnit(jW,f,K)) followed by αW equals αX followed by relativeMVUnit(jW′,f′,K′). No covering, quasi-coherence or compactness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Transpose the relative unit under the adjunction for j followed by f. By the defining right-adjoint mate equation for relativeMVImageComp, its transpose is relativeMVComp(j,f) inverse followed by Lj of the counit for f. Naturality and the triangle identity for j cancel its unit. This is the private unit_counit calculation, valid for any scheme morphism j.

For the identity coefficient map, transpose the source and target paths under the adjunction for the inverse-image open followed by f prime. Expand the base-change map using its counit definition. Naturality of the square comparison and the relative-unit transpose put the source into its local-square counit formula and the target into its global-square counit formula (private source_counit and target_counit).

Apply coefficient_square_pasting to g, f, W inclusion, f prime, g prime, and the two open pullback projections, with the identity coefficient map on Lg(Rf K). The pullback condition and hpull.w give its square and rectangle equalities. Invert the resulting comparison identity by precomposing with the inverse comparison factors and postcomposing with the global square factor. Naturality of the open pullback comparison moves the counit through it, identifying the two path transposes. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves the identity-coefficient square.

Factor the arbitrary local coefficient map as the identity-coefficient local map followed by direct image of the pulled-back coefficient map. Naturality of the relative unit moves that coefficient map to the global factor. Associativity and preservation of identity maps finish the required square. The argument uses no assumptions on the open, so includes empty and full opens and arbitrary coefficient maps.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_restriction_unit
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (W : X.Opens) :
    (derivedPullback g).map (relativeMVUnit W.ι f K) ≫
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ W).hom =
      (relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ).hom ≫
        relativeMVUnit (pullback.fst g' W.ι) f' K'
